escaped_commands.description: Lines GitLab would have run as quick actions, sent with a leading backslash so they show as text

command.description: The command name, without the slash

input.description: The input the line was in

line.description: The 1-based line number in that input

milestone.description: The milestone as GitLab reported it after the write, or before a delete; updated_at is the witness the next write takes

untrusted_title.description: The title, which is what issues and merge requests are filtered by

outcome.description: created, updated, deleted, unchanged or dry_run

id.description: The numeric project id; the stable way to address it

moved_from.description: The old path the project was addressed by, when GitLab reported it moved; null otherwise

path.description: The full path, such as group/sub/project

visibility.description: public, internal or private: who can see what was written

would_send.description: The request a dry run did not send; null when something was written

fields.description: The request fields that would be sent; only these would change

operation.description: What the request does, such as create an issue
